slides.title: Bolt
slides.narration: A ninety-second guide to Bolt, from the AiGovOps Foundation and the NCW AI Camp.

slides.title: What it is
lines: Bolt (bolt.new) is a browser-based AI developer that writes, runs, and deploys full-stack apps in a live environment.
You describe what you want and it scaffolds the whole thing, letting you preview instantly.
It offers free daily credits, with paid tiers for heavier use (and it's in Lenny's bundle).
slides.narration: Bolt (bolt.new) is a browser-based AI developer that writes, runs, and deploys full-stack apps in a live environment. You describe what you want and it scaffolds the whole thing, letting you preview instantly. There's a free tier to start.

slides.title: What's cool for NCW
lines: Educators: prototype an interactive lesson activity or a small quiz app to try with a class
SMB owners: build a landing page or a simple internal tool and deploy it the same afternoon
Community leaders: mock up a program microsite to show stakeholders before committing budget
slides.narration: Here's what's cool for our valley. Educators can prototype an interactive lesson activity or a small quiz app to try with a class; SMB owners can build a landing page or a simple internal tool and deploy it the same afternoon; Community leaders can mock up a program microsite to show stakeholders before committing budget.

slides.title: The rules — the AiGovOps way
lines: A human on the trigger — you read it before it goes out
Keep the receipts — save your prompt and the answer
Mind the data cost of “free” — no student records, IEPs, or private details in a free tool
slides.narration: Now the rules, the AiGovOps way. Keep a human on the trigger: you read it before it goes out. Keep the receipts: save your prompt and the answer. And mind the data cost of free — never paste student records, an I-E-P, or a customer's private details into a free tool, because free tools learn from what you type.
